source: It also lets you want suffering to end without that wish turning into desperation or fear of failure.
owner_meaning: Mettā is a goodwill wish for suffering to end, not trying to force/achieve the outcome; the forcing project is where desperation and fear of failure arise.
existing_owner_context_before:
I realized it doesn’t help to spread negativity just because misery loves company. I’ve been preaching metta ever since 😊❣. Still trying to realize that deeper tho!
In the Metta Sutta, you wish ease and happiness to beings, yourself included. Metta calms the hindrances and builds goodwill.
existing_owner_context_after: Theravada and most Mahayana Buddhist traditions treat metta as essential groundwork before the deeper work of unweaving the sense streams that make up the mind.
